successors.name: Cholula
successors.text: 'this part of the Tlaxcala–Puebla valley' (Cacaxtla's 30 km hegemony without the city of Cholula)

ledger.x: 650: Cacaxtla and Xochitécatl rise under the Olmeca-Xicalanca.

c. 650–750: after 'the fall of the nearby city Cholula (c. 650 – 750)', 'Cacaxtla became the hegemonic power in this part of the Tlaxcala–Puebla valley'. The Battle Mural, 'Dating from prior to 700', shows the wars of the period. The year is the end of the page's range.
900: Cacaxtla's 'ascendancy came to an end around 900 CE and, by 1000, the city had been abandoned'.

certainty.note: A city-state hinterland drawn as a radius.
